soundness_flags.label: ass:proxy-stability and lem:causal-identification
soundness_flags.one_line: Rolling pseudo-events cannot assess the event-date counterfactual transport equality itself; give a falsifiable institutional/data-generating regime or present the theorem explicitly as conditional on this untestable transport restriction.

soundness_flags.label: ass:no-spillovers, ass:limited-anticipation, ass:proxy-stability, and lem:causal-identification
soundness_flags.one_line: For the displayed equality, consistency and proxy stability already identify the contrast; no-spillovers and limited anticipation do no stated logical work, while the definition of m_s already says it is transported.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 1–3; ass:attainable-local-modulus
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The lower donor-location modulus, which supplies the N^{-kappa} converse channel, is assumed through a novel one-direction attainability condition rather than derived from the panel primitives.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The four-channel frontier and honest-length claims are conditional on ass:attainable-local-modulus; this assumed focal rate channel caps the proposal at field tier.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 7 gives uniform squared pointwise local-polynomial risk; Algorithm 2 sample-splits and evaluates the second-stage estimator at an independently estimated strongly-convex minimizer, and Theorem 8 bounds minimum-value estimation.
The paper constructs conditional synthetic-control prediction intervals; Appendix A explicitly extends its main result to beta-mixing data using blocking and coupling.
Stone states optimal finite-Lq regression rates n^{-(p-m)/(2p+d)} and the logarithmically modified sup-norm counterpart under regularity conditions.
Fan analyzes local-linear MSE and minimax efficiency and explicitly covers fixed and random design regression.
The paper derives finite-sample optimal confidence intervals and sharp efficiency bounds for linear regression functionals over convex classes under normal errors with known variance.
The paper relates minimax estimation of linear functionals in Gaussian indirect-data experiments to the modulus of continuity over a convex class.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Rewrite proxy stability as a clearly conditional transport premise, specify an institutional regime that motivates it, and distinguish pre-event falsification checks from verification of event-date transport.

Remove no-spillovers and limited anticipation from the identification lemma unless a separate transport result derives proxy stability from them; otherwise retain them only where they have an explicit substantive role.
Add a worked non-affine, nondegenerate data-generating example satisfying the attainable local modulus and compute its full-covariance donor channel, making the field-tier condition operational.
State a boundary corollary comparing the generated-center experiment against the exact-center and all-training-coordinates-noisy experiments on a common scalar submodel.

recommended_next_step: Revise the transport assumption and minimize the identification assumptions, while retaining the conditional field-tier four-channel frontier.
